text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock B and Stock E after gains felt satisfying, but a gain alone doesn't tell me whether selling is best for my overall account.","I held through the ups and downs in Periods 2, 4, and 5; with my infrequent trading, patience can be preferable to reacting to every monthly change.","Selling Stock C at a gain reinforced how much I value avoiding the pain of losses; I should remember that this feeling can shape my choices, and consider each holding on its merits."]}
